description: The full delivery loop: Ironside Street, Meltwater Row, Voss Avenue, and out to Cinder Lane, in that order or not at all. 20₵.
name: The Loop

{who} picks up the pace through Ironside Street, checking the time.
{who} ducks through Ironside Street at a dead sprint.
{who} pushes on through Meltwater Row, counting the stops left out loud.
{who} keeps jogging, sweat starting to show.
{who} weaves through Meltwater Row without breaking pace.
{who} cuts across Voss Avenue without breaking stride.
{who} barely slows down crossing Voss Avenue.
{who} vaults a low railing on Voss Avenue, showing off a little.
{who} staggers out to Cinder Lane, done running errands for one day.
{who} slows to a walk as Cinder Lane comes into view, thank god.
{who} bends over, hands on knees, finally at Cinder Lane.
